configuration: DanceTrack, pedestrian, SKIP_SPLIT_FOL=True, DO_PREPROC=False; exact existing pinned CLI settings
pre_utility_validation: All nine metrics for every arm of the three frozen pilot windows must reproduce the existing CLI to absolute tolerance 1e-10
sampling: All previously preregistered causal event arms; no utility/effect-selected subset
reward_window: Original k=1..100 future frames only, excluding action-time t. Current correctness separately retained. Incomplete rewards are null, never negative or zero-filled.
L5_value: 0.5 * paired delta HOTA + 0.5 * paired delta AssA versus own same-prestate KEEP, computed by official preprocessing and metric implementations
